statement: Complete unramified local normal forms for the full, metabelian and single-cusp marked groups, with the actual triangular comparison maps and every full lifting fiber.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d)
notes: The kernel filtration is R intersect gamma_r(Pi), not the intrinsic lower-central filtration of R. Its graded kernels are saturated by the actual Fox and marked-ideal comparisons.
The full fiber over z_Q is exactly H1(Z3,R,Ad(z0)F). Every full preimage is unramified because the quotient preserves V and full ramified sections have nonzero cusp inertia.
The coordinate map is b_r=pi_bar(a_r)+epsilon_r(a_<r), where epsilon_r and the next unique conjugator are defined by the genuine nonlinear Frobenius on specified Hall lifts.

The all-degree local factors and kernel factors are finite lattice cokernels. At q4 the precision bound is3^(r+b_r+1). All factors through degree4 are evaluated with exact maps and inverse Smith coordinates.
The actual E54 arithmetic quotient supplies a separate nonlinear normalizer test and an explicit triangular correction1+a-b modulo3. It is not substituted for the rank-ten arithmetic group.
At q4, the first full-to-metabelian fiber factor is C3^228 x C9^183 x C27^36 x C81^109, and the first full-to-marked fiber factor is C3^5 x C9^2.

Root and D independently audited the full proof and freshly ran copied sources. Both complete JSON certificates are identical with no fields omitted. The shifted illustrative target is expressly nonpointed; the main maps retain pointed representatives. Full audits PASS.
